corrections.text: The headline says "Google Open-Sources TPU Sync". The verb follows Google's post ("available today as open source") and The New Stack, but the code was not first made public on November 9, 2026. The Herald's check of the GitHub API on November 10 shows the same repository, then named TPU Raiden, had public forks from June 2026 and an open pull request from May 12, 2026, and PyPI lists tpu-sync-jax and tpu-sync-torch nightly builds from September 16, 2026. November 9 was the launch under the TPU Sync name; none of the cited sources states when the code first became public.
